name: jian
description: Gateway de agentes com identidade e contexto compartilhados entre sessões

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @jian/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jian/sdk build && pnpm --parallel --filter @jian/contracts --filter @jian/gateway --filter @jian/gateway-ui dev
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @jian/contracts build && pnpm --filter @jian/sdk build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm contracts:check
scripts.apple:index: cd apps/apple && xcode-build-server config -project Jian.xcodeproj -scheme Jian && xcodebuild -project Jian.xcodeproj -scheme Jian -destination 'platform=macOS' -skipPackagePluginValidation build | xcode-build-server parse -a

lint-staged.packages/contracts/src/**/*.ts: sh -c 'pnpm contracts:generate && git add packages/contracts/openapi.json packages/sdk/src/generated.ts'
